title: Orchestrator mode roles are enforced by the PreToolUse hook; the mod only selects
what: roles.rs derives the role from agent_id/agent_type: main thread and other subagents are read-only, anvil-executor writes only inside SCOPE paths granted from the Agent brief. State is local in .harness/.state/orchestrator.json. The anvil-mode mod draws the selector and rewrites model and effort at turn.step
why: User wants the orchestrator never to touch code and the executor to do only what it was told
learned: Use agent_id, not agent_type, to tell subagents from the main thread; scopes are unioned per session because parallel executors cannot be matched to their brief at PreToolUse
author: reactive-end
